HGSS Black Star Promos

Released February 10, 2010 · 25 cards

HGSS Black Star Promos is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the HeartGold & SoulSilver series, released in English on February 10, 2010. It has 25 cards. It includes 24 Pokémon, 1 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

13 illustrators worked on HGSS Black Star Promos. Most cards: Kouki Saitou (4), Masakazu Fukuda (4), Wataru Kawahara (3), match (2), Noriko Hotta (2), Takashi Yamaguchi (2), TOKIYA (2), Hideaki Hakozaki (1).
